name: SV Annotation & Classification
nameZH: 结构变异注释与致病性评估
overview: 基于 AnnotSV 的结构变异注释与致病性分级流程，覆盖 >20 个注释数据库（ClinVar/ClinGen/OMIM/gnomAD 等），支持 ACMG/ClinGen 五级致病性分类、HPO 表型驱动优先级排序和 SNV 交叉验证假阳性过滤。
overviewEn: AnnotSV-based SV annotation and pathogenicity classification pipeline covering >20 annotation databases (ClinVar/ClinGen/OMIM/gnomAD etc.), supporting ACMG/ClinGen 5-tier classification, HPO-driven prioritization, and SNV cross-validation false-positive filtering.

references.title: AnnotSV: an integrated tool for structural variations annotation (Geoffroy et al., 2018)
AnnotSV and knotAnnotSV: a web server for human structural variations (Geoffroy et al., 2021)
Technical standards for the interpretation and reporting of constitutional CNVs (Riggs et al., 2020)

steps.name: 安装与注释库下载
steps.description: 源码安装 AnnotSV v3.5.10 并下载人类注释数据库
steps.descriptionEn: Install AnnotSV v3.5.10 from source and download human annotation databases

tools.name: git clone + make
tools.params: make PREFIX=. install && make PREFIX=. install-human-annotation
tools.notes: conda 安装需单独运行 INSTALL_annotations.sh。
tools.notesEn: Conda install requires separate annotation download.

steps.notes: 推荐源码安装，注释库自动下载。

steps.name: SV 注释
steps.description: 对 SV VCF/BED 进行多数据库注释，生成 TSV 注释表
steps.descriptionEn: Multi-database annotation of SV VCF/BED, producing TSV annotation table

tools.name: AnnotSV
tools.notesEn: Covers >20 databases: ClinVar, ClinGen, OMIM, gnomAD, dbVar, DGV.

steps.name: 表型优先级排序
steps.description: 基于 HPO 术语对 SV 进行表型驱动的优先级排序
steps.notes: HPO 术语驱动 Exomiser 引擎表型-基因型关联排序。
steps.notesEn: HPO terms drive Exomiser engine for phenotype-genotype ranking.

steps.name: 假阳性过滤
steps.description: 利用 SNV/indel 数据交叉验证 SV 真实性

tools.name: AnnotSV -snvIndelFiles
tools.notes: 大缺失区域杂合 SNV 提示假阳性。
tools.notesEn: Heterozygous SNVs in large deletions indicate false positives.

steps.notes: 检测大缺失区域杂合 SNV，假阳性 SV 标记过滤。
steps.notesEn: Flag false-positive SVs via heterozygous SNV detection in large deletions.

steps.name: ACMG/ClinGen 致病性分级
steps.description: 自动计算 ACMG/ClinGen 五级致病性评分（Class 1-5）

tools.name: AnnotSV 自动 ranking
tools.notes: Class 5 (>=0.99) 致病, Class 4 (0.90-0.98) 可能致病, Class 3 VUS, Class 2 可能良性, Class 1 (<=-0.99) 良性。
tools.notesEn: Class 5 (>=0.99) P, Class 4 (0.90-0.98) LP, Class 3 VUS, Class 2 LB, Class 1 (<=-0.99) B.

steps.notes: 基于 Riggs et al. 2020 ACMG/ClinGen 联合共识。
steps.notesEn: Based on Riggs et al. 2020 ACMG/ClinGen consensus.

steps.name: 结果过滤与输出
steps.description: 提取致病/可能致病 SV（Class 4-5），输出多格式结果

tools.name: AnnotSV -rankFiltering
tools.notes: 输出 TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM，HTML 含交互式 knotAnnotSV 可视化。
tools.notesEn: Output TSV/HTML/VCF/XLSM, HTML with interactive knotAnnotSV.

steps.notes: 仅保留 Class 4-5，交互式 HTML 用于临床审核。
steps.notesEn: Keep Class 4-5 only, interactive HTML for clinical review.
